hash_algorithm: SHA-256 over exact file bytes (not Git blob SHA)

gates.detail: 8 source/fixture integrity tests plus hash-freeze receipt verification; LOCKED rows used only for source integrity, never calibration

hash_freeze: Accepted canonical fixture bytes after E1 PASS; carry these SHA-256 values into the release run receipt.
scope: E0/E1 evidence integrity only; no model, E2, E3 evaluation, or release claim.
percentage_summary_convention: % = count/192, population SD, and sig/avg = SD/mean are contract-defined (A15 and §8.7). Performing summary statistics on 100*circle_count/192 before rounding individual percentages is an implementation inference, not explicitly specified by the source or contract; this inference reproduces the published p.82 summary values.
claims_allowed: Fixtures match the primary pages as transcribed; derived energy columns are internally consistent at source print precision.
warnings: Implementation correctness is not physical validation.
Full model-run receipt schema (Â§8.8/E8) has not been implemented or validated.
energy_consistency_convention: The 186.5–187.5 mg mass interval is contract-defined (§8.7). Source velocities are printed to 1 m/s and energies to 0.1 J. Treating those displayed values as nearest-rounded intervals (±0.5 m/s and ±0.05 J) is an implementation assumption, not explicitly specified by the source or contract. The assumption is used only for source-consistency checking; it is not a fitted physical parameter or a model tolerance.
